name: verify
description: Headless UI verification: a zero-dependency browser driver over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, a project feature map, and skills that drive and check them.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the installed Chrome headlessly from a shell to check a running app and capture evidence.
interface.longDescription: Headless UI verification without browser MCP tools. A zero-dependency Node driver speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol to the user's installed Chrome: it boots the app when needed, drives it by test ids or visible text, asserts, captures grammar-named screenshots at fixed viewports and cleans up only what it started. Skills pair the driver with a project feature map.
